drugs.name: maropitant (injectable)
drugs.notes: Once daily up to 5 consecutive days. Prevomax EU/UK: 1 mg/kg = 1 mL/10 kg SC or IV bolus (do not mix with other fluids). Give >1 h before trigger for prevention. NOT for motion sickness. Cerenia injectable (FDA): same 1 mg/kg SC/IV (≥4 mo; dogs 2–4 mo SC only). Injectable must not be used interchangeably with tablets for motion sickness.
drugs.source: Prevomax 10 mg/ml EU SPC / VMD UK SPC https://www.vmd.defra.gov.uk/productinformationdatabase/files/SPC_Documents/SPC_2116038.PDF ; FDA DailyMed CERENIA Injectable setid=6aeda328-97c9-4868-8ecb-b3a4dcdbc0a0

drugs.name: maropitant (tablets — vomiting/chemo)
drugs.notes: Dogs only (≥8 wk EU). Acute vomiting / chemo nausea EXCEPT motion sickness: 2 mg/kg PO once daily (EU tablets up to 14 days). Hospital stock: 16 mg and 24 mg. Weight bands (vomiting): 16 mg — 3.0–4.0 kg ½; 4.1–8.0 kg 1. 24 mg — 8.1–12.0 kg 1; 12.1–24.0 kg 2. Dogs <3 kg: correct dose not accurately achievable per 16 mg table. If actively vomiting, start injectable then switch.
drugs.source: Cerenia 16/24/60/160 mg tablets EU/UK SPC & VMD QRD Jan 2025 https://www.vmd.defra.gov.uk/Productinformationdatabase/files/QRD_Documents/QRD-Auth_2243321.PDF

drugs.name: maropitant (tablets — motion sickness)
drugs.notes: Dogs only (≥16 wk EU / ≥4 mo US). Prevention of motion-sickness vomiting: 8 mg/kg PO once daily, max 2 consecutive days. Give ≥1 h before travel (EU). NOT the injectable 1 mg/kg or tablet vomiting 2 mg/kg regimen. Injectable must not be used for motion sickness. Hospital stock strengths 16 mg and 24 mg (label also uses 60/160 mg for larger dogs).
drugs.source: Cerenia tablets EU/UK SPC/QRD motion-sickness section https://www.vmd.defra.gov.uk/Productinformationdatabase/files/QRD_Documents/QRD-Auth_2243321.PDF ; Zoetis US / DailyMed Cerenia tablets
